name: Brainrot Wars
detailed_description:
Brain Are Gain!

Brainrot Wars is a free-to-play turn-based casual game where memes meet mastery. Collect loot every 3 hours, and craft your own hero army. It's a meme-fueled lootfest with real economy and tradeable rewards through Steam Inventory.

1️⃣ Season 1

  • 6 free heroes

  • 12 combining heroes (6 rare, 4 epic, 2 legendary)

  • Guess character minigame

  • Many trinkets (for this season only)

2️⃣Season 2

  • Arena public and ranking mode with your characters.

  • 18 heroes (6 common, 6 rare, 6 epic, 2 legendary)

  • Even more trinkets (binding to this season)

3️ Season 3

  • Arena rank mode extended with draft mode (picks and bans) starting from 10000 rating of player

  • 18 heroes (6 common, 6 rare, 6 epic, 2 legendary)

  • Even more trinkets (binding to this season)

4️⃣ Season 4

  • Artifacts - combining trinkets into one powerful artifact. One hero can hold only one artifact and make it more powerful. It is very rare, suitable only for ranked battles. With big power..

  • 18 heroes (6 common, 6 rare, 6 epic, 2 legendary)

  • Even more trinkets (binding to this season)

⚔️ 3v3 Turn-Based PvP Battles (Future mode)

Assemble a team of 3 heroes and dive into intense turn-based combat. Chain skills, manage mana, and outsmart your opponents using powerful ability synergies. Every match is a tactical challenge where brainrot meets big-brain plays.

🃏 Hero Collection & Crafting

Collect dozens of unique heroes, each with 4+ abilities and meme-infused themes. To play on certain hero, you to craft them, you'll need:

  • 60 shards of that hero (Dropped from chests or other activities)

  • 4–9 trinkets (Dropped only from locked chests and every 3 hours) 
    Only by combining the right junk with the right shards can you unlock new warriors for your roster.

🔥 Features

  • Got 15 lower-rarity heroes? Fuse them into 1 of a higher tier (legendary heroes are excluded).
    Plan your upgrades and manage your inventory for the most efficient progress.

  • Purge hero, shards, trinkets to get a coins and acquire "brain link" or buy another chests.

🎁 Loot System with Hourly Drops

Every 3 hours, claim random trinket from a rotating drop pool:

  • Common - 70%

  • Uncommon - 25%

  • Rare - 4.89%

  • Epic - 0.1%

  • Ultra Epic - 0.01%

  • Legendary - 1 in 500 000

  • Planetary wide - 1 in 5 000 000

  • Universe wide - 1 in 50 000 000

Drops are tied to your progress and engagement, providing constant rewards and collection growth. Idle? No problem—rewards keep stacking.

🕹️ Mini-Games & Daily Missions

Play short mini-games to earn chest shards (1–3 depending on performance). Complete daily quests to grab even more shards and resources. Every action pushes you closer to your next full hero.

🗓️ Daily Login Rewards

Log in daily to earn free loot: chests, hero shards, or even pieces of legendary heroes. Don't miss a day—each login gives progress and power.

📦 Chests & Economy

3 Chest Types:

  • Omni Chest – grants random hero shards, trinkets (small chance), fully creafted hero(small chance, up to Rare)

  • Hero Chest – gives a fully crafted hero

  • Epic Hero Chest – rare and powerful, requires a key

All chests rotate seasonally, every ~2 months. New rewards and keys arrive each season, keeping the game fresh and exciting.

🔑 Keys & Trade System:

  • Chests can be bought, traded, or sold

  • Keys are non-tradeable and can only be bought directly

  • Trinkets are tradeable

  • Shards (chests or heroes) are non-tradeable

  • Full Heroes are tradeable

Steam Inventory integration gives you full control—build your collection, trade on the market, or fuse items for higher rarity.
